list.name: patch
list.label: Patch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT patch FROM gold.gold_champion_meta_by_patch ORDER BY 1 DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_matches FROM gold.gold_patch_summary WHERE patch = '$patch'
SELECT avg_duration_min FROM gold.gold_patch_summary WHERE patch = '$patch'
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.gold_champion_meta_by_patch WHERE patch = '$patch'

panels.title: Tier list - Winrate par champion (>= $min_picks picks)

targets.rawSql: SELECT champion_name AS "Champion", most_common_position AS "Rôle", picks AS "Picks", round(winrate * 100, 1) AS "Winrate %", round(pickrate * 100, 1) AS "Pickrate %", kda AS "KDA", avg_cs_per_min AS "CS/min" FROM gold.gold_champion_meta_by_patch WHERE patch = '$patch' AND picks >= $min_picks ORDER BY winrate DESC
SELECT champion_name, round(pickrate * 100, 1) AS pickrate_pct FROM gold.gold_champion_meta_by_patch WHERE patch = '$patch' ORDER BY pickrate DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Évolution du winrate entre patchs (champions >= $min_picks picks)

targets.rawSql: SELECT champion_name AS "Champion", patch AS "Patch", picks AS "Picks", round(winrate * 100, 1) AS "Winrate %", round((winrate - lag(winrate) OVER (PARTITION BY champion_name ORDER BY patch)) * 100, 1) AS "Delta vs patch précédent" FROM gold.gold_champion_meta_by_patch WHERE picks >= $min_picks ORDER BY champion_name, patch

SELECT champion_name AS "Champion", round(presence * 100, 1) AS "Presence %", round(banrate * 100, 1) AS "Banrate %", round(pickrate * 100, 1) AS "Pickrate %", round(coalesce(winrate, 0) * 100, 1) AS "Winrate %" FROM gold.gold_champion_bans_by_patch WHERE patch = '$patch' ORDER BY presence DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Builds gagnants - items par champion (patch $patch, >= 10 builds)

targets.rawSql: SELECT champion_name AS "Champion", item_name AS "Item", times_built AS "Builds", round(winrate * 100, 1) AS "Winrate %" FROM gold.gold_champion_items_by_patch WHERE patch = '$patch' AND times_built >= 10 ORDER BY winrate DESC LIMIT 30
